# Large downloads that these tools keep in a .cache folder in your user folder.
# Other .cache folders are backed up, because the name alone does not say what

# out.

**/.cache/whisper
**/.cache/puppeteer
**/.cache/selenium
**/.cache/pre-commit

# Intentionally NOT excluded: .git, worktrees, lockfiles, build, dist, out,
# bin, obj, target, vendor, and ordinary project exports.

# This list comes with Rewindle and changes only with a Rewindle update. Do not
# edit the installed copy: Rewindle checks it against its list of installed
# files, so an edited copy stops restores, repairs and changes to your folders
# or backup location until Rewindle is reinstalled. To back up less, remove a
# folder on the Protection page.
